description: This file contains shell script code for testing wildmatch pattern matching, including functions for testing pattern matches, handling external dependencies, and executing a series of pattern matching test cases.

methods.name: should_create_test_file
methods.description: Determines if a test file should be created based on its name and environment prerequisites.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Performs a pattern match test using a specified matching function and expected outcome.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Performs a pattern match test via 'git ls-files' with specified expectations.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive set of pattern matching tests with various options and expectations.
